title: electrodialysisStack operation
description: Electrodialysis stack: N cell pairs of alternating cation/anion-exchange membranes moving salt from the diluate to the concentrate under a DC current. Name the hardware as a record (`stack <name>;`, kind edStack) or type its geometry inline -- one home, and the two refuse side by side. Give `current` to impose the amperage, or `targetDemin` to ask for a demineralisation fraction and let the current be solved. The run checks the applied current against the LIMITING current -- predicted from the ion diffusivities under a stack record, or the legacy Cowan-Brown form on a declared transport number -- and announces the margin: above i_lim the diluate boundary layer is ion-depleted and water splitting takes over, which is a regime, not a bigger number. The DC power (P = U·I) is published on an energy wire as W_electric, mirroring the shaft-wire convention, so a rectifier (`electricLoad`) absorbs it.

stack.title: Stack record
stack.description: The stack named as a RECORD (assets catalogue or the case's constant/assets/, kind edStack): it supplies the cell pairs, the active area (THE CELL-PAIR AREA of the whole stack), the channel and spacer, the hydraulic passes, the stack's own Sherwood correlation and its limits {}, which are checked against the run and announced. Declaring `N_cellpairs`, `membraneArea`, `channelThickness`, `channelLength`, `linearVelocity`, `hydraulicPasses` or `spacerPorosity` beside it refuses by name (one home), and so does `membrane` where the record's own source names a pair. The crossflow velocity is DERIVED from the diluate flow and the channel section and printed with its arithmetic. Every value the record marks `origin estimate` is announced on every run.

limitingCurrent.title: Limiting-current model
limitingCurrent.description: Which i_lim model runs. `GeraldesAfonso2010` PREDICTS the limiting transport numbers from the ion diffusivities and the diluate composition (J. Membr. Sci. 360 (2010) 499-508, Eqs. 12/13/15) and reads no declared transport number; it needs the stack record's own Sherwood correlation, so it is reachable only under `stack`, and a case that declares it without one refuses by name. `CowanBrown` is the legacy single-salt working form on the membrane record's declared t_cu. Omitted, the engine takes GeraldesAfonso2010 where a stack record supplies the correlation AND every diluate ion resolves a diffusivity AND both signs are present, CowanBrown otherwise -- announcing which, and why.

N_cellpairs.title: Cell pairs
N_cellpairs.description: Typed INLINE; required only when the case names no `stack` record, and REFUSED beside one.

membraneArea.title: Area per cell pair
membraneArea.description: Typed INLINE; required only when the case names no `stack` record, and REFUSED beside one. The area ONE CELL PAIR presents to the current, which is what the current density is taken on; a stack record declares the whole stack's cell-pair area instead and this is derived from it.

channelThickness.title: Spacer gap
channelThickness.description: Typed INLINE; required only when the case names no `stack` record, and REFUSED beside one.

channelLength.title: Flow-path length
channelLength.description: Used by the Leveque film correlation of the CowanBrown route; defaults to 0.5 m. Typed INLINE; required only when the case names no `stack` record, and REFUSED beside one.

linearVelocity.title: Cross-flow velocity
linearVelocity.description: The crossflow velocity of the no-record form only; defaults to 0.05 m/s, announced. Under a `stack` record it is REFUSED, because it is the diluate flow on the inlet stream divided by the channel section the record describes -- derived and printed with its arithmetic.

current.title: Applied current
current.description: Imposed-current form. Raw SI (amperes). Give this OR targetDemin.

targetDemin.title: Target demineralisation
targetDemin.description: Solved-current form: fraction of the diluate's salt to remove; the current is the result.

xi.title: Current efficiency
xi.description: Fraction of the charge that moves salt; defaults to 0.9, announced.

E_electrodes.title: Electrode overpotential
E_electrodes.description: Lumped electrode + electrode-rinse voltage, added to the stack voltage; raw SI (volts), announced.

membrane.title: Ion-exchange membrane pair
membrane.description: Resolved by name (kind IEM), e.g. CMX_AMX; supplies the area resistances and counter-ion transport numbers. A stack record whose own source names a pair supplies it and REFUSES this key; a record whose source names none requires it here.
